Let’s be real by the time a Top 8 Stocks to Buy Now video hits YouTube, institutions have already front-run the move and are looking for someone to sell to.

​Buying naked equity exposure into a market this top-heavy is a coin flip. If macro rolls over next month, all 8 of those picks are going down with the ship regardless of how good their earnings look.

​I gave up trying to out-pick the market makers a long time ago. 
Put my side book into  Strat Delta  to run strictly delta-neutral setups instead. Let the retail crowd gamble on stock lists and drive up options premiums, it makes way more sense to sit in the middle and harvest the volatility math whichever way the market breaks.
